description: Read one owned review with compact proposal rows, statuses and edit IDs. A suggestion shows applying while an approved change is being sent to Meta, then applied or failed. Each row has userEdited {value, note}; when the user changed a suggestion before approving it, suggestedAfter and suggestedReason hold the original suggestion and after and reason hold what the user chose. revisions[] lists each change with who made it, before and after, and restored_to_agent when the original was put back. Duplications include copies[].status (pending, approved, made, partial, failed, rejected), group for split post requests, and summary.copies totals. A partial copy already exists in Meta; its row carries id, currentName, failedStep, a plain error and retry (available, how). Returns 50 proposals by default; paging.after continues and detail: full returns full proposal data.

detail.description: Compact rows by default. Full includes operations, changes and editable fields.

name: ads_get_edit_review
title: Read an Edit Review
